name: Natalya Petrovna Volkova
source: Hailing from faraway Russia, Natalya is a lively, radiant ball of energy, always with a big smile and a lighthearted joke to share with her friends. Being a sheltered rich girl new to both the school and the country, she's eager to meet new people and try out new things that strike her very flighty fancy. To her, the world is one big rollercoaster ride, with twists and surprises at every turn--and you can certainly bet she's raring to discover them.
